title: GPU costs, quota visibility and spending boundaries
guidance: Current researched HF PRO list price is $9/month with 40 included ZeroGPU minutes per reset period. Published large allocation is 48GB at 1x quota, xlarge 96GB at 2x; overage is $1 per 10 normalized minutes using credits. Recheck provider rules before financial decisions. Allocation ceilings are not actual usage; measure receipts. Another public ZeroGPU Space still uses caller allowance. Inference API billing and hardware hosting are separate categories; a spending allowance is not available credits. Current Main and Control use free CPU Basic. Fresh balance may be unavailable; never present historical $3.68 or old quota as live. Credit-top-up discussion is not purchase or spending permission. Existing paid authority remains $0 until a specific grant. GPU hold and exact-plan gates remain authoritative. Keep existing architecture; shared budget ledger and compute router are proposed, not implemented. Never silently change models or retry an uncertain submitted task. Prioritize current film before rental benchmarking or hardware ownership.
